about.text: Aralac was the American casein fibre, developed by the research arm of National Dairy Products from skim-milk casein and marketed around 1940. It was blended with wool, mohair, rayon and fur felt, and milk-protein fibre was no longer made in the US by the end of the 1940s.

how.text: Made on the same principle as Lanital: casein spun to filaments and hardened.
